space: normalized (train-standardized) units; author reduction = mean over windows x steps x channels

identity.row_order: the author test loader's order (shuffle=False), consumed in full

errors.reduction: exact float64 sums over every window x step x channel

percentage_errors_zspace.note: ratios in the centered z-space, NOT physical percentage errors; diagnostic only

matched_baselines.persistence: last input value repeated over the horizon, same windows
matched_baselines.seasonal24: DONE for steps <= 24; APPROXIMATE beyond (the value 24 h before the step wraps inside the input window)
matched_baselines.mae_relative_to_test_persistence: MAE / persistence MAE on the SAME test windows (not MASE: the denominator is not the training-set naive scale)

quantiles.note: read from the histogram; not an exact order statistic

correlation_r2.rule: Pearson needs positive variance in BOTH series; R2 needs positive true variance

autocorrelation.rule: lag L needs W > L + 1; consecutive windows overlap by construction, so no 1/sqrt(W) band is claimed; no PACF, no spectrum

per_window_series.use: paired contrasts between seeds and against the matched baselines, per window

paired_contrasts.note: seed-to-seed and model-vs-baseline paired contrasts are computed at closure from the per-window series of the cells

independent_check.rule: |global - author float32| <= 1e-6; per-step and per-channel means reproduce the global within 1e-9; naive equals the closure's within 1e-6
